about.title: Our purpose
about.subtitle:
More than
just Global Shipping,
our job is
to look inside
your business
and develop the logistics system
that works best for you.
about.text1: Connecting suppliers to the international market, giving small and medium exporters the chance to compete fairly on the global stage.
about.text2: We exist to enable the growth of these businesses by offering access to logistical conditions they could not achieve alone.
about.text3: What sets us apart is our approach. We look deep inside client companies to find the best solutions and configure the optimal service package.
about.text4: We focus on a close, human, and straightforward relationship backed by a modern operation that is technology-integrated and, above all, uncomplicated.
quem_somos.title: Who we are
quem_somos.text1: We leave complexity and spreadsheets behind so you can focus on your business growth.
quem_somos.text2: The world of international logistics is vast and full of challenges, but we believe that every company, regardless of size, deserves a dedicated logistics partner.
quem_somos.text3: Our focus is to support the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), offering them the expertise and structure previously accessible only to major players.
quem_somos.text4: With Artha Log, you have the peace of mind that your supply chain is in the hands of experts committed to finding the smartest and most efficient solution for your cargo, whatever the volume of your operations.
cards.title: The Artha way of doing
cards.card1.title: Logistics to anywhere in the world
cards.card1.description: Complete management, from initial capacity planning and tariff management, through booking on vessels and flights, to final transport.
cards.card2.title: Intelligence and Automation from Start to Finish
cards.card2.description: We have direct access to online information on flights and vessels for the world's main ports and airports. This saves your team precious time and increases accuracy, ensuring your cargo is always in the right place at the right time.
cards.card3.title: Precise and Uncomplicated Container Management
cards.card3.description: Complex container and terminal operations become simple. Our management system optimizes and automates every step, from yard arrival to shipment, ensuring total fluidity.
cards.card4.title: Direct Connection to Ports
cards.card4.description: Direct connections with major carriers, agents, and authorities at the world's busiest ports. The result? Less waiting time and more savings for your operation.
features.feature1.title: Global Trade without Borders
features.feature1.description: Navigate the complex world of international trade with total peace of mind. We take care of all bureaucracy and legal requirements so your company remains compliant, ensuring your goods cross borders without issues.
features.feature2.title: Intelligence for Your Business
features.feature2.description: Work smarter, not harder. We apply the best solutions to accelerate your processes and provide the insights you need to make optimized decisions, boosting your entire team's efficiency.
features.feature3.title: Maximum Performance Transport
features.feature3.description: Transform your transport into a profitability engine. We optimize your routes and operations to ensure maximum efficiency, reducing costs and increasing the performance of every delivery.
features.feature4.title: Connected Port Operations
features.feature4.description: We guarantee your port operations are fluid and efficient. Through an integrated network, your cargo moves quickly and without bottlenecks, from the vessel to the final destination.
features.feature5.title: Data-Driven Logistics
features.feature5.description: We use the power of information to build a more efficient supply chain. With accurate, real-time data, you anticipate problems, optimize routes, and make strategic decisions that keep your company always one step ahead.
